name: dexter-claude-mcp-server
description: Remote (HTTP + OAuth) MCP server giving Claude — in Cowork, not a Hermes profile — cross-project read access to Dexter's project context (state/dossier/transcript), plus the same gated write tools (dexter_propose_phase, dexter_add_agent_task, dexter_append_dossier, dexter_log_activity) the Dexter agent itself uses via mcp-server/index.js. See README.md for setup (tunnel + OAuth wiring) and server/store.js's 'Agent action gating' section for what 'gated' means here.
